title: Osmosis
stalemate: Dead end — no card can reach a foundation any more.
selectSource: First select a card (waste or a reserve top card)

frontendHint.moveToFoundation: A card can seep into a foundation

tutorial.foundation: Four vertical foundation rows. The top row collects one suit in any order; lower rows accept only ranks already present in the row directly above (osmosis).
tutorial.reserve: Four reserve columns. Move the top card of any column to a foundation.
tutorial.stockWaste: Click the stock to draw one card. Use the top of the waste on a foundation.
tutorial.actionButtons: Action buttons: hint, auto-complete, undo, give up.
